column3: Shared the pace early - settled into second before halfway - pressed the front pair three furlongs out - pushed alongside approaching two out then hit the front - stumbled slightly on the surface soon after - moved clear entering the straight - stayed on strongly to the finish

Shared advantage early - moved clear briefly after 1f - challenged 3f out - drawn level and driven with over 2f out - overtaken approaching final 2f - stayed on at unchanged effort to finish 2nd beaten 6 lengths
Settled towards the rear early - travelling keenly - improved into 5th by halfway - pushed up to 3rd approaching the final 3f - unable to threaten in front and stayed on same speed to finish third
Held up in the pack early - pushed into 6th place approaching the final 3f - stayed on at one speed to the line - finished 4th
Up with the front group - 4th at halfway - moved to 3rd 4f out and hard at work soon after - plugged on without finding extra to finish 5th
Held up towards the back - pushed along into 7th approaching 3f out - unable to find further improvement and stayed on at one speed to finish 6th
Sat close to the front pair - third at halfway - urged on with 4f left - fifth and unable to close 3f from home before fading to finish well held
Settled towards rear early - 7th at halfway - pushed along but unable to make headway over 3f out - well beaten in 8th
Held a midfield position - pushed along and unable to quicken 3f out - dropped away to finish well beaten in 9th
Settled midpack early - slipped towards the back by halfway - dropped away with no response from 4f out - well held at the finish
Reluctant to enter the stalls - settled in the pack - pushed along with nothing left 4f out and dropped away to finish last
Set the pace from the start - driven along inside the final two furlongs and challenged close home - held on well to prevail

Tracked leading group early - niggled for response when boxed in with 2f left - eased across left approaching final furlong under pressure - closed on leader inside last but never got there - kept on for second beaten a short head

Held up towards the back - found room and made progress inside the final 2f - pushed along approaching the furlong marker - shifted left when boxed in and stayed on without further improvement close home to finish third
Held up towards the back - urged into contention 2f out but boxed in - kept to same pace under pressure inside final furlong to finish 4th
Settled in the pack early - pushed along and made ground over 2f out - well placed with a furlong left - held rate to the line for 5th
Sat close to the pace early - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away shortly after and slipped back before the final furlong - unable to find more inside the last 110yds finishing sixth
Held up towards the back - pushed along with two out and lost touch with the front by the furlong pole - stayed on late but only made slight late progress inside the final 110yds to finish seventh
Held up eagerly early in mid-pack - pushed along and made ground over 2f out - unable to find more and finished well held
Refused to line up - took no part
Front from the off and showing the way - a mistake at the 2nd before retaking control at the 3rd - a bold leap 4 out to move clear - challenged before 2 out and under pressure - stuck on to prevail
Sat handy behind pace - 4th at halfway - pushed along in 5th 3 out - into 3rd and closing 2 out - stayed on to finish 2nd
Settled in rear - 6th at halfway - moved into 3rd after 4 out and up to 2nd 3 out - challenged at the front before 2 out - found nil on the run-in - plugged on at one tempo to finish 3rd
Sat close to the pace - third at halfway - pushed along three out and slipped to fourth - held no more in reserve and finished fourth
Settled midpack early - hit a couple of small errors around 6th and 7th - untidy again 6 out then pushed along and dropped back 3 out - couldn't find more late and finished well held in 5th

Front early and sharing the pace - not quite clean at the 2nd - lost the advantage soon after - back in 2nd at halfway - small error 5 out - pushed along after 4 out - 3rd approaching 3 out before a mistake and nothing more to give - finished 6th
Held up at back - drifted right at the opener - pushed along with little response by 3 out and unable to find more after - well held at the finish
Settled in the pack early - began to close in from 2f out - pushed along a furlong from home - hit the front 110 yards out - held on gamely for the win
Held up at back - driven and made strong progress over 2f out - hit front 1f out - overtaken 110yds out - battled to the line for 2nd
Held up towards the back - made strong progress but boxed in approaching final 2f - eased right for space and pushed along inside final furlong - kept on well to close late for third
Held up in the pack - pushed along and made progress over 2f out - well placed with a furlong left - stayed on at one tone but edged out of third close home
Took a strong hold early - hit the front after a furlong - pushed along with two to go - overtaken a furlong out - held effort through the closing stages without finding more - beaten into 5th
Sluggish start settling at the back - urged into contention 3f out - drifted left under pressure 2f out - crept through late to finish sixth
Settled in the pack - improved into contention over 2f out - pressed for effort a furlong out but found nothing - faded to finish 7th
Up with the pace - pushed along over 2f out - dropped away markedly before the final furlong - eighth

Sent forward from the off - clear in front briefly before being overtaken after a furlong - pushed along with three left - form gave way in earnest soon after - dropped away over a furlong out and trailed home ninth
Settled just behind the pace - shared 3rd spot early - hit the front soon after - shaken up to move ahead before two out - strolled home unchallenged

Set the pace early - pressed and hit the front briefly 3rd before losing top spot - lost touch and drifted left at the 6th - unable to threaten those in front - urged along 3 out - rallied to fight for second 2 out - held that spot without troubling the winner - came home second beaten 15 lengths

Sat close behind pace early - clipped heels at the 4th - up to second by the 6th - hit the deck at the 5th from home - pressed for effort 3 out - unable to close on the front-runner - stumbled 2 out and slipped back to third - held that spot but faded through the finish

Settled towards the back early - urged into contention around 2f out - shifted course left approaching the final furlong - responded strongly through the closing stages - closed on the front-runner with under 110yds left - got up to score near the line
Handy early - asked for effort with 2f left - hit front inside final furlong - overtaken close home and could not respond
Settled behind front-runner - pushed along to hit the front approaching 2f out - overtaken with a furlong left - held effort through final furlong - unable to find more close home finishing third
Keen early in front - driven when overtaken 2f out - unable to find more inside final furlong - finished fourth
Fought for control early - settled mid-pack - pressed for effort 2f out - stayed on same pace inside final furlong to finish 5th
Dwelt at the break - settled towards the back - pressed for effort 2f out but found little - held throughout to finish sixth

Settled just behind the front group - 5th at halfway - headway approaching 2 furlongs out - driven along and shared 2nd - went up alongside before the last and stumbled slightly on landing - hit the front early in the straight - stayed on strongly to win

Sat just behind the front group early - 6th at halfway - error at the second-last while making headway - had to be niggled along as battled into 2nd - fighting hard for 3rd approaching the last - stayed on to the finish without troubling the winner
Settled midfield early - moved into contention before 2 out and into 5th after it - pushed along in 4th turning for home - held level effort to finish third
Settled rear - headway 2 out and moved into 5th - hard at work in the straight - one-paced to finish 4th
Settled around midfield - pushed into 6th before final two furlongs but couldn't threaten leaders into the straight - stayed on at one speed to finish 5th
Held up towards the back - pushed along and edged closer approaching 2 out - eighth turning into the straight and stayed on without reaching contention

Went straight to front - hit the 6th and again 2 out - challenged approaching last and drew level there - pushed along and lost command entering the straight - unable to find more thereafter - finished 7th
Sat close to the pace early - 4th at halfway - pushed along and unable to quicken 2 out - finished 8th
Settled in the pack - made no inroad when asked 2 out and finished ninth
Sat close to pace early - disputed second at halfway - pressed after two out but couldn't quicken and faded before the last
Settled in the pack early - pushed along and dropped towards the back two out - unable to find any headway - finished well beaten in 11th
Held up in the pack - lost touch before 2 out - well beaten at the finish
Sat close to the pace early - third at halfway then found little under pressure - dropped away to finish last
Sat close up early - lost momentum after a small error 6th and dropped to midfield - faded from before 2 out to finish well beaten in 14th
Held up towards the back - pushed along with no headway after the second-last - came down at the final fence
Held up towards the back - still behind the pack with four to jump - stopped and was withdrawn before the following obstacle
Settled mid-pack early - made ground three out and asked for effort two out - hit the front approaching the final furlong drifting right under pressure - sprinted away close home to score
Settled in the pack early - made progress three furlongs out - pressed for effort with two to run - stayed on at one gauge inside the final furlong to finish second unable to match the runaway winner
Sent to front early - pushed along approaching 2f out - lost the advantage inside final 2f and eased over left-handed - responded to finish third
Held a forward position early - pushed along approaching 2f out then seriously impeded over a furlong out - continued at an even effort to finish fourth
Up with the early leaders - niggled 3f out - under pressure 2f out - plugged on at one speed inside the final furlong
Sluggish start - settled at back - made progress into contention 3f out - pushed along 2f out - checked in run over a furlong out and unable to regain momentum
Held up towards the back - urged into effort with 3f left - lost touch under pressure and let down over the closing furlongs

Handy early and drifted left over the opening fence - settled just behind the pace - upsides at halfway - shared the advantage three out - pushed along after the second-last - hit the front early in the straight and stayed on strongly to the line
Settled close up early - hit front after the first - matched for command 3 out - pressed for effort after 2 out - lost advantage entering straight then held on for second
Settled in midfield early - up handy in 5th at halfway - improved to 3rd approaching 2 out - unable to close on pair in front once asked - stayed on same rate to finish 3rd
Bumped a touch at the opener - sat just off the front group - 4th at the midway point - pushed along approaching two out - unable to gain ground thereafter and simply held on for 4th

Jumped to the front before sharing the lead - dropped back to 3rd by halfway - nudged along in 5th approaching 2 out and unable to make any mark on the principals - plugged on at one speed to finish 5th
Bumped at the first - settled midfield - moved into 6th approaching two out - pressed for effort but unable to close and finished one-paced
Hampered at 1st - towards back of field then pushed along into 8th after two out - unable to make further headway late on
Bumped early - settled towards back of pack - still back at halfway - pushed along into 7th two out - unable to threaten and blundered final fence
Held up at back - hint of a blunder 6th - pushed along and lost touch 2 out - finished well adrift
Held up in the pack - pushed along with nothing to give approaching two out - dropped away and finished well beaten
Erratic and clipped first fence hard - settled midfield - scratchy again second - asked for more before two out but found little then dropped away to finish last
Held up towards the back - drifted right at 1st and hint of error 2nd - pushed along with nothing more to give 4 out then pulled up
Travelled keenly early - set the pace throughout - never seriously pressed - won going away
Tracked front-runner - urged forward with three furlongs left - driven approaching final two - stayed on at one gauge to the line for second

Settled in the pack early - urged forward and made progress 3f out - needed driving under 2f out then drifted left showing inexperience inside final furlong - unable to threaten leaders but rallied close home to finish third
Sluggish start and settled towards the back - urged into progress 3f out - under pressure 2f out - eased left inside the final furlong - finished strongly to be fourth
Settled towards the back - driven into contention 3f out - asked for effort 2f out - kept going late to finish 5th
Pulling hard early - sat behind the pace - pushed along 3f out - found nothing under pressure - dropped away inside final furlong - finished sixth
Keen early in the pack - pressed for effort 3f out - unable to land a blow finishing 7th
Held up towards the back - pushed along with 3f left - unable to threaten the front end - finished well held in 8th
Hesitant to break and dropped well back early - settled at the tail showing inexperience - never able to challenge and well beaten at the finish
Settled in the pack early - pushed along 3f out but failed to find any extra - dropped away 2f out to finish well beaten
Set the pace from the start - challenged twice through the middle stages but held the advantage before the last - driven clear approaching the final fence - stayed on strongly to the line for the win

Settled towards the back - blundered 5th - up to 4th after that - improved into 3rd but faltered 2 out - pressed on to take 2nd near the last - continued well through the finish but couldn't catch the winner

Handy early up with front pair - disputed second spot - back on terms before 3 out - blundered there - pushed along into second after the following fence - held that spot but weakened before last - stayed on same stride to finish third
Settled in rear - moved up to 3rd place - minor error at the 5th - 4th and under pressure 2 out before plugging on without ever threatening

Up with the front group early - dropped to 4th after the 3rd - back in the field after the 5th - niggled 3 out before a small error 2 out - soon had nothing more to give - modest error at the last and well beaten 5th
Took keen hold early - hit the front after 1f - urged along 2f out and kept up the effort inside the last - edged away approaching the line - scored with plenty in hand
Held up towards back - progress into contention 3f out - pushed along with 2f to go - stayed on inside final furlong but well beaten into 2nd
Raced close up early - drifted right approaching 3f out - pressed for effort with 2f left - maintained effort but couldn't quicken final furlong - held on for third without finding more late
Jumped well - in front briefly before surrendering the lead after 1f - pushed along over 2f out with nothing to give - dropped out of contention in the final furlong to finish 4th
Settled in fourth early - showed inexperience when asked for effort with 2f left - never able to land a blow late on - eventually beaten well into fifth
Settled at the back early - moved into contention over 2f out - pushed along with a furlong left - powered home edging left inside the final 110yds to prevail close home
Handy early - roused along and hit front over 1f out - caught close home to finish second by a short head
Held a midpack position early - pushed along with two furlongs left - rallied through the closing stage - claimed third close home but unable to reel in the leading duo
Went straight to front - pressed for effort and lost command inside final furlong - squeezed for space as faded close home - finished fourth
Settled in the pack early - moved up into second place with 4f left - pushed along to press the leader before fading over the closing furlong to finish fifth
Settled towards the back - eased over to the right and pressed for effort with 2f to go - unable to land a blow through to the line - finished sixth
Held up handy in the early stages - urged forward with 2f left - dropped away inside the final furlong to finish 7th
Settled in the pack - pushed along with over 2f left - unable to respond and beaten into 8th
Settled in rear early - pressed for effort with 2f left - unable to land a blow - beaten into 9th
Sat just behind front group - small error 4th and holding that spot at halfway - pushed along 2 out - battling for 3rd and hit last - powered home up the rail - got up to win late

Set the pace early - dropped to third then fifth before edging closer under urging - drew alongside approaching the last and drifted left - hit the front turning into the straight - stayed on well - caught in the final strides to finish second by half a length

Broke a touch right at the opener - settled just behind the pace and sat handy into third - up to second by halfway - upped the tempo from fifth to sit right on the front-runner - moved through nicely to challenge approaching the final fence - took a knock and needed driving there - overtaken turning into the straight - held third but couldn't find more late on

Sat handy early travelling keenly - up with the front group and third for a spell - still third at halfway - small stumble three out - asked for more but found little before the final fence - stayed on without gaining finishing fourth
Small error at the opener - settled towards the back of the pack - moved into 6th approaching two out - unable to close and finished one-paced to the line
Tracked the front group early - 5th at halfway - pressed after the second-last but unable to close and stayed on at one gear to finish sixth
Settled in the pack - pressed for effort 2 out - dropped away late - eventually finished seventh well beaten
Held up in the pack - pushed along with little response 2 out - dropped away late to finish 8th
Settled in the pack early - pushed along with little response 2 out - dropped away late to finish 9th
Held up towards the back - made no impression through the race - dropped away 2 out - well held at the finish
Held up towards the back of the pack for much of the way - unable to find more with two furlongs left - dropped away late to finish 11th
Held up at the back throughout - hit the 4th and made little impression - dropped away before 2 out
Settled up with the pace early and edged wide at the first meeting a minor knock - eased back and dropped towards the back - last of all with three furlongs to go and unable to find more
Blundered and unseated at the 1st
Held up towards the back - hit first - found nothing more approaching three out - dropped away and pulled up promptly two out
Handy with the pace - boxed in briefly approaching final furlong - eased left to find space and quickened sharply - hit the front close home - stayed on strongly to score

Settled handy in third early - driven up towards the front pair from 2f out - full of hope wide out with a furlong left - closed on the winner inside the last 110yds - held no more late but kept second

Settled handy early - moved up on front group approaching two out - drifted left and clipped another runner over a furlong out - found third spot inside the final furlong - stayed on well to hold off a late challenge
Settled towards back of pack - improved position from the furlong marker before closing on the front group inside final 110yds - stayed on well to finish fourth
Settled towards the back early - shifted to find room and made progress over a furlong out - stayed on late without threatening the leaders to finish fifth
Held up towards the back - driven approaching final 2f - lost place and dropped away close home
Held up handy in first rank - shifted through middle of track to press on 2f out - found little inside final furlong and lost place late
Settled close up early in second - hit front over 2f out - pressed and lost advantage inside final furlong - caught up in traffic approaching the furlong marker - dropped away in the closing stages
Settled towards the back - lost touch with leading group approaching the final furlong - stayed on at one speed to the line - finished 9th

Held mid-pack early - drifted wide through the field - lost touch with rivals 3f out - urged along and edged closer inside final 2f - lost momentum in the closing furlong - dropped away near the finish to come home 10th
Set the pace early - driven on with two furlongs left before being overtaken with a furlong to run - dropped away quickly after
Held up towards back of field - pushed along with 1f left - stayed on same gear late to finish 12th
Settled in the pack early - travelling wide of rivals - lost touch with the front end 3f out - slipped towards the back and finished well held
Settled mid-pack early - urged forward with two furlongs left - powered clear in the final furlong - got up to win right on the line
Handy early - hit front after 2f - pushed along inside final furlong and stayed on well - overtaken near the line to finish second
Settled in the pack early - moved into third with 3f left - pushed along inside the final furlong and briefly took second - edged back to third near the line - stayed on to finish third
Settled just behind the pace - asked for effort 2f out - improved into fourth close home - finished fourth beaten 3.75L
Set the pace early - lost command but stayed close before being pushed up to challenge 2f out - faded inside final furlong to finish 5th
Settled in the pack - urged forward over 2f out - unable to respond and beaten into 6th
Settled towards back of field - pushed along approaching final 2f - unable to land a blow - finished well beaten in 7th
Settled at back of field - urged forward with 3f left - unable to land a challenge - trailed home well beaten in 8th
Near the front early - dropped away 3f out and faded fast into the 2f marker - allowed to finish in own time well held in 9th
Settled close to the pace early - hit the front past halfway - powered clear inside the last furlong - comfortable winner at the line
Settled in the pack early - lost ground before halfway - pushed along and made progress a furlong out - moved into second inside the final 110 yards - kept going to the line
Held up at the back - short of room approaching the final furlong and had to be patient - gap appeared late and stayed on strongly to claim third
settled in the pack - driven into contention approaching final furlong - briefly up to second - faded inside the last 100 yards to finish fourth
Held a forward position early - still up with the pace passing the furlong marker - lost momentum inside the last - eased back to finish fifth
Close to the pace early - asked for effort a furlong out but found little inside final 110yds - dropped away towards the line
Held up towards the back - pushed along to close ground middle of track over a furlong out - lost momentum inside final 110yds and dropped away late
Settled in the pack - driven to close ground with a furlong left - lost touch inside the final furlong and faded near the finish
Hesitant start - held towards the back throughout - crept past a fading runner close home but no threat to the front end
Sent clear early - lost the advantage after halfway - driven approaching final furlong then dropped away to trail near the finish

Sat behind pace early - moved into second spot with 2f left - pushed to close on the front-runner inside the final furlong - hit the front 110yds out then faced immediate rivalry - edged home in a tight finish
Handy early - hit front two out - driven along and challenged inside final furlong - lost advantage close home - battled back gamely to prevail
Settled just behind the pace - pressed for effort with 2f left - moved into fourth a furlong out - improved into third and kept on to finish 3rd
Settled in the pack early - driven and dropped back approaching 2f out - responded to finish fourth in the closing stages
Settled in behind leading group - pressed for effort with 2f left - unable to close the gap - finished 5th
Settled towards rear - under pressure 4f out and made no impression from 2f out - finished well beaten in 6th
Sent clear from the break - driven to keep advantage but overtaken 2f out - dropped away in the final furlong to finish 7th
Sent to the front early - lost the advantage after 2f but stayed handy - closing on the pace 1f out - regained control inside final 110yds - kept finding to score

Settled handy on the wide side early - moved into second before halfway - hit the front over 2f out - pressed for effort inside the final furlong - overtaken close home - couldn't find more and just missed

Settled mid-pack early - began to close from over a furlong out - moved wide and closed on the front-runners with a furlong left - poised to strike inside the final 110 yards - couldn't find more and held for third
Held up towards the back - urged forward to close from the furlong marker - stayed on through the last furlong - unable to match the front three inside the final 110yds and finished fourth
Held up in the pack - urged forward in pursuit two out - faded in the closing stages to finish fifth
Held up towards the back - pulling hard early - pushed along and made progress inside final furlong - stayed on to finish sixth
Held up in the pack - urged forward with 2f left and made a little progress inside the final furlong - lost ground close home to finish seventh
Held up in the pack early - driven to close on the front group with a furlong left - lost momentum inside the last 110yds - finished 8th
Handy early - hit front after 2f then lost command 2f out under pressure - dropped away inside final furlong
Poor start - stayed towards the back - no impact on the finish - eventually came home 10th
Settled just behind pace - driven into contention inside final two furlongs to hit front - kept finding late to win
Tracked pace early - pushed along over a furlong out and hit front - drifted left approaching final furlong before losing advantage - stayed on to finish second beaten a length and a quarter
Sent clear early - pushed along a furlong out - lost the advantage entering the last and squeezed for room momentarily - stayed on to finish third
Raced enthusiastically early up with the front group - asked for effort a furlong out - unable to find more finishing 4th
Sat close to the pace early - pushed into contention 2f out - pressed for run inside final furlong - faded quickly to finish fifth
Set the pace from the off - drew clear from 3f out - driven approaching final 2f and drifted left inside the last 110yds - held on well to score
Settled mid-pack early - improved into contention with over a furlong left - moved up into second inside final 110yds - stayed on to the line just short
Settled second early - shadowed leader from past 2f out - dropped a place under pressure inside final 110yds and unable to find more
Held up at back of field - improving from 2f out and moved wide over a furlong out - stayed on without threatening near the finish - finished fourth
Sluggish break - settled towards back travelling wide - lost touch with pace 2f out - found renewed energy to close inside final furlong - unable to get on terms at the line
Settled in the pack - squeezed for space with two furlongs left - stayed on steadily to the line without threatening
Dwelt at the break - settled last - driven on with 2f left - boxed in inside final furlong before fading close home
Handy in the pack early - driven approaching final furlong - lost touch and faded close home
Close to pace early - urged on approaching 2f out then lost ground - dropped away fast inside the final furlong
Hesitant to break and away tardily - stuck at the back alone through early stages - found a little late progress inside the final furlong to stay on to the line
Handy in leading group early - urged for effort with 2f left then under pressure inside final furlong - dropped away fast near the line
Shared the front early - clear from 1f - pushed out approaching final furlong to assert and stay on strongly for the win
Sat close to the pace early - pushed along with a furlong left - moved into runner-up spot inside the final 110yds to finish second
Settled in behind the pace - pressed for effort inside final furlong and kept responding - edged out for second close home
Shared front spot early - lost the advantage but stayed in touch through the second furlong before being driven with a furlong left - lost place inside the final 110yds to finish fourth
Settled in behind leaders - pushed along inside final furlong - unable to make headway - finished fifth
Held up in the pack early - improved into second spot 3f out - hit the front inside the final 2f - pressed on under urging in the closing stages to assert late
Settled towards the back - pressed for effort with a furlong left - made ground close home to move into second - stayed on but unable to get closer at the line
settled at the back and drifted right early - angled through into contention from over 2f out - lost pace a furlong out - found renewed energy in the last 110 yards to claim third close home
Settled in second early - urged forward approaching final two furlongs while up with the front-runner - overhauled by winner close home - dropped to fourth at the line
Went straight to front - lost the advantage inside final 2f - dropped away fast close home - finished fifth
Settled in third early on - dropped back 2f out - faded fast approaching final furlong - trailed off at the finish
Settled in the pack early - lost touch after halfway as others quickened clear - allowed to finish in own time last furlong - well held in 7th
Settled in the pack early - moved into contention with 2f left - driven to close in on leaders inside the final furlong - hit the front approaching the line - stayed on well to score
Pulled hard early up with the pace - gained ground 2f out - pushed along a furlong out - grabbed second close home beaten three quarters of a length
Handy early - pushed along over 1f out - hit front briefly before being overtaken inside final furlong - edged out for second close home
Settled mid-division - dropped back and unable to match tempo 1f out - kept on to finish 4th without ever looking dangerous
Sat close to the front group early - pushed along with a furlong left - stayed on at one speed to finish fifth beaten a length and a half
Went straight to front - pushed along and overtaken inside final furlong - dropped away close home

Settled just behind the pace early - hit the front before halfway - driven up and lost the advantage for a moment approaching the last furlong - regained command inside the closing stages and kept finding more to win
Held up towards the back and slipped to last before halfway - responded with a strong surge from a furlong out - stayed on well to grab runner-up spot close home

Held a forward spot early - drifted through the middle of the track - hit the front approaching 2f out then lost that advantage inside the final furlong - couldn't find more and edged back into third close home
Held up towards back - driven into contention approaching final furlong - stayed on to snatch fourth close home but lacked the speed to get closer
Set the pace early - lost the advantage before halfway - driven approaching the last furlong - faded close home to finish 5th
mid-pack early - closed on the front-runners approaching the furlong pole then pushed along - lost momentum close to home
Held up at the back - urged forward with under a furlong left - dropped away close home - finished 7th
Held up at the back - never able to land a blow and drifted off a true line approaching the furlong marker - faded close home to finish well beaten
